0022600129.text: The Pistons (3-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) are at the Knicks (0-3, 13th in the East) for Detroit's fourth game of the season, with a three-game winning streak and a 2-0 road record. Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain for Detroit, while Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and New York is without Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but Detroit won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 126-111 win in New York on February 19, 2026.
